name: Why Tile Floors Crack — and What It Says About the Subfloor
title-tag: Why Tile Floors Crack | Mukilteo Tile Installation
meta-description: Cracked tile is a symptom, not a defect: deflection, missing membranes, slab movement. How to read the crack pattern and decide between repair and rebuild.
post-summary: January 26, 2027 · Tile almost never cracks on its own — a cracked floor is the floor filing a report about what is underneath it. How to read the crack pattern: deflection past L/360, a skipped uncoupling membrane, slab movement, or hollow voids. Plus the honest economics of repair versus rebuild in Mukilteo's split-level housing stock.
